name: melio-remotion-mcp-app

tools.name: read_me
tools.description: IMPORTANT: Call this FIRST. Returns the guide overview and lists all available rule tools.

tools.name: rule_react_code
tools.description: Project code reference: file structure, supported imports, component/props patterns

tools.name: rule_remotion_animations
tools.description: Remotion animations: useCurrentFrame, frame-driven animation fundamentals

tools.name: rule_remotion_timing
tools.description: Remotion timing: interpolate, spring, Easing, spring configs, delay, duration

tools.name: rule_remotion_sequencing
tools.description: Remotion sequencing: Sequence, delay, nested timing, local frames

tools.name: rule_remotion_transitions
tools.description: Remotion transitions: TransitionSeries, fade, slide, wipe, flip, duration calculation

tools.name: rule_remotion_text_animations
tools.description: Remotion text: typewriter effect, word highlighting, string slicing

tools.name: rule_remotion_trimming
tools.description: Remotion trimming: cut start/end of animations with negative Sequence from

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Create or update a video. The `files` param is a JSON string (not an object) mapping file paths to source code. Pass it as: files: JSON.stringify({"/src/Video.tsx": "...your code..."}). For edits, only include changed files — previous files are preserved automatically.

files.description: REQUIRED. A JSON string of {path: code} mapping file paths to source code. Example: '{"/src/Video.tsx":"import {AbsoluteFill} from \"remotion\";\nexport default function Video(){return <AbsoluteFill/>;}"}'. For edits, only include changed files — unchanged files are kept from the previous call.

entryFile.description: Entry file path (default: "/src/Video.tsx"). Must match a key in files.

title.description: Title shown in the video player

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Render the CURRENT session's video to an MP4 file on disk and return the saved file path. DO NOT call this automatically. ONLY call it when the user EXPLICITLY asks to save, export, download, or render the video as a file (e.g. "save this as an mp4", "export the video to a file"). Creating, previewing, or editing a video with create_video does NOT imply rendering — never trigger this as a follow-up to create_video on your own. Requires a video to have been created first via create_video in the same session. Server-side rendering uses a headless browser and may take a while; it is intentionally a separate, explicit step.

outputPath.description: Absolute (or relative) filesystem path where the rendered .mp4 file should be written, e.g. "/Users/me/Desktop/video.mp4". Must end in .mp4. Parent directories are created if missing.
